content.contents: cold ass hands i've got RIGHT NOW. they're so cold it hurts really it hurts my hands are SO cold it's crazy. idk why this happens maybe it's a circulation problem?????
first work paycheck hit like crazy bonkerspilled i mean motherfucker i got new tripp NYC motherfuckin rave ass rave pants and an NC State wolfpack sweater. gonna pair it with my lows!!!!!!!

i love being alive right now. i've been listening a lot to elliott smith (not much has changed). i really like from a basement on the hill, he was channeling somethin different!! it was so cool. dude was just badass.

i'm very tired, but i feel like i've pushed a large boulder to a peak, and i feel like there's a bit of a dip in the proverbial hill. like for a little bit i don't have to push and i can kind of just enjoy the view. i've worked really hard but things are good right now. the sun felt like it was setting for a while, now it feels like it's changing it's mind. :3
i really love making music so god damn much. idk if anyone will read this but, if you do, thanks for reading and thanks for listening!!!
working makes me so damn tired but it makes the time i get to work on my music that much better!!!
